content.text: The letter reports the sleeve's net, gross, YTD, and trailing-12-month returns, but never mentions the comparison index or its 3.4% Q3 return — so the client has no reference point showing the sleeve trailed its policy blend.

points.evidence: The letter's Performance Update section lists only the sleeve's own figures — net 2.9%, gross 3.1%, YTD 6.1%, trailing 12 months 8.7%. There is no mention anywhere in the letter of the comparison index, the real assets policy blend (40% global listed infrastructure / 30% global REITs / 20% US TIPS / 10% broad commodities), or its Q3 2026 return of 3.4%. The benchmark comparison is omitted entirely, so the reader cannot see that the sleeve underperformed its policy blend.
